text_to_say: नमस्ते! म हाब्रे। आऊ, सँगै अक्षर सिकौं!
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Namaste! I'm Habre. Let's learn letters together!)

text_to_say: फेरि भेट भयो! यात्रा जारी राखौं।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Welcome back! Let’s keep going.)
Habre, warm and playful. (How old are you?)

text_to_say: हाब्रेले तपाईंको नानीसँग कुन भाषामा कुरा गरोस्?
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Which language should Habre speak to your child?)
Habre, warm and playful. (Finish the earlier steps first.)

text_to_say: हाब्रेलाई निद्रा लाग्यो! आज यति नै। भोलि फेरि खेलौं।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Habre is sleepy! That's all for today. Let's play again tomorrow.)
Habre, warm and playful. (Trace over the letter with your finger.)

text_to_say: सुन त! कुन चित्र हो? छोऊ।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Listen! Which picture is it? Touch it.)

text_to_say: एउटा अक्षर छान, अनि मात्रा छोऊ।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Pick a letter, then tap a vowel sign.)
Habre, warm and playful. (Listen! Which vowel sign makes this sound?)

text_to_say: आऊ, नेपाली शब्द सिकौं! चित्र छोएर सुन।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Let's learn Nepali words! Touch a picture to hear it.)
Habre, warm and playful. (Touch a number and let's count together!)
Habre, warm and playful. (Which story shall we hear? Touch a book.)

text_to_say: बाजा बजाऊ वा चित्रमा रङ भर!
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Play Nepali instruments or colour a picture!)
Habre, warm and playful. (Touch an instrument to play it!)

text_to_say: एउटा रङ छान, अनि चित्रमा छोऊ।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Pick a colour, then touch the picture.)

text_to_say: हाम्रो झण्डा सिमरिक रातो र निलो हुन्छ, जून र घाम सेता।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Our flag is crimson and blue, with a white moon and sun.)
Habre, warm and playful. (Wow! Just like our real flag!)

text_to_say: हाम्रो वर्णमाला मुखको नक्सा हो! आवाज कहाँबाट आउँछ, हेरौं।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Our alphabet is a map of the mouth! Let’s see where each sound comes from.)

text_to_say: अङ्ग्रेजी अक्षरका आवाज सिकौं: s, a, t, p, i, n!
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Let's learn English letter sounds: s, a, t, p, i, n!)

text_to_say: हरेक आवाज छोऊ, अनि तीरमा औंला सार!
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Touch each sound, then slide along the arrow!)
Habre, warm and playful. (Listen carefully — which picture?)
Habre, warm and playful. (Which one starts with this sound?)

text_to_say: यो अङ्ग्रेजी आवाजको नेपाली साथी कुन?
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (Which Nepali letter makes this English sound?)
Habre, warm and playful. (Hold your hand in front of your mouth: feel the air?)
Habre, warm and playful. (Touch your throat: does it buzz?)
Habre, warm and playful. (The sound comes through your nose!)
Habre, warm and playful. (The microphone isn't on — ask a grown-up.)

text_to_say: यो खेलका लागि पहिले ठूलाले आवाज रेकर्ड गर्नुपर्छ।
notes: Habre, warm and playful. (A grown-up needs to record the sounds for this game first.)

text_to_say: धेरै धेरै पहिले, काठमाडौं उपत्यका एउटा ठूलो ताल थियो।
notes: Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Long, long ago, the Kathmandu Valley was a big lake.)

text_to_say: तालको बीचमा एउटा चम्किलो कमलको फूल फुल्यो।
notes: Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (In the middle of the lake, a shining lotus flower bloomed.)

text_to_say: मञ्जुश्रीले आफ्नो तरवारले चोभारको डाँडा काटिदिनुभयो।
notes: Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Manjushri cut open the hill at Chobhar with his sword.)
Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (All the water of the lake flowed away.)

text_to_say: त्यहाँ हरियो उपत्यका बन्यो, अनि मानिसहरू बस्न थाले।
notes: Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (A green valley appeared, and people came to live there.)

text_to_say: कमल फुलेको डाँडामा आज स्वयम्भू छ!
notes: Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 6: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Today, Swayambhu stands on the hill where the lotus bloomed!)

text_to_say: धेरै पहिले, लुम्बिनीको बगैंचामा राजकुमार सिद्धार्थ जन्मनुभयो।
notes: Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Long ago, Prince Siddhartha was born in a garden in Lumbini.)

text_to_say: एक दिन उहाँले घाइते हाँसलाई माया गरेर बचाउनुभयो।
notes: Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (One day, he lovingly saved a hurt swan.)

text_to_say: उहाँ रूखमुनि शान्त भएर बस्नुहुन्थ्यो र सोच्नुहुन्थ्यो।
notes: Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (He would sit calmly under a tree and think.)

text_to_say: पछि उहाँ गौतम बुद्ध हुनुभयो र सबैलाई शान्ति र दया सिकाउनुभयो।
notes: Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Later he became Gautama Buddha and taught everyone peace and kindness.)

text_to_say: बुद्ध जन्मनुभएको ठाउँ, लुम्बिनी, हाम्रो नेपालमा छ!
notes: Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Lumbini, where the Buddha was born, is in our Nepal!)

text_to_say: सगरमाथा संसारकै सबैभन्दा अग्लो हिमाल हो।
notes: Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Sagarmatha is the highest mountain in the whole world.)

text_to_say: माथि धेरै चिसो हुन्छ र हावा चल्छ, चढ्न निकै गाह्रो छ।
notes: Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Up high it is very cold and windy, so climbing is very hard.)

text_to_say: सन् १९५३ मा तेन्जिङ नोर्गे शेर्पा र एडमन्ड हिलारी सँगै चढ्नुभयो।
notes: Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (In 1953, Tenzing Norgay Sherpa and Edmund Hillary climbed together.)
Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (On the way, they helped each other.)

text_to_say: अनि टुप्पोमा पुग्नुभयो! सँगै मिलेर काम गर्दा ठूलो काम पनि सकिन्छ।
notes: Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (And they reached the top! Working together, we can do big things.)

text_to_say: दशैं आयो! सबै परिवार घरमा भेला हुन्छ।
notes: Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Dashain is here! The whole family comes home.)

text_to_say: घरमा जमरा उमारिन्छ — सानो, हरियो बिरुवा।
notes: Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (We grow jamara at home — little green shoots.)

text_to_say: ठूलाबडाले निधारमा रातो टीका लगाइदिएर आशीर्वाद दिनुहुन्छ।
notes: Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Elders put red tika on our forehead and give us their blessings.)

text_to_say: केटाकेटी चङ्गा उडाउँछन् र पिङ खेल्छन्।
notes: Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Children fly kites and play on the swing.)
Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (At Dashain, we all celebrate happily together.)

text_to_say: तिहार बत्ती र दियोको चाड हो।
notes: Story "Bright Tihar", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Tihar is the festival of lights and lamps.)

text_to_say: हामी काग र कुकुरलाई माया गरेर खाना र माला दिन्छौं।
notes: Story "Bright Tihar", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (We lovingly give food and flower garlands to crows and dogs.)

text_to_say: गाईको पूजा गर्छौं, अनि घर सफा गरेर सजाउँछौं।
notes: Story "Bright Tihar", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (We honour the cow, then clean and decorate our homes.)

text_to_say: दिदीबहिनीले दाजुभाइलाई सात रङको टीका लगाइदिन्छन्।
notes: Story "Bright Tihar", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Sisters give their brothers a seven-coloured tika.)
Story "Bright Tihar", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Everyone sings Deusi and Bhailo and dances!)

text_to_say: यो हाम्रो झण्डा हो। संसारमा यस्तो आकारको झण्डा अरू कतै छैन!
notes: Story "Our Flag", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (This is our flag. No other flag in the world has this shape!)

text_to_say: यसका दुई त्रिकोण हिमालका चुचुराजस्तै देखिन्छन्।
notes: Story "Our Flag", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Its two triangles look like the peaks of the Himalaya.)

text_to_say: यसको सिमरिक रातो रङ लालीगुराँसजस्तै छ।
notes: Story "Our Flag", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (Its crimson red is like the rhododendron flower.)
Story "Our Flag", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (It has the moon and the sun.)

text_to_say: जून र घाम रहुन्जेल नेपाल रहोस् भन्ने चाहना यसमा छ।
notes: Story "Our Flag", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm. (It carries the wish that Nepal lasts as long as the moon and the sun.)

text_to_say: Long, long ago, the Kathmandu Valley was a big lake.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: In the middle of the lake, a shining lotus flower bloomed.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Manjushri cut open the hill at Chobhar with his sword.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: All the water of the lake flowed away.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: A green valley appeared, and people came to live there.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Today, Swayambhu stands on the hill where the lotus bloomed!
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Lake and the Lotus", page 6: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Long ago, Prince Siddhartha was born in a garden in Lumbini.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: One day, he lovingly saved a hurt swan.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: He would sit calmly under a tree and think.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Later he became Gautama Buddha and taught everyone peace and kindness.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Lumbini, where the Buddha was born, is in our Nepal!
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "The Story of the Buddha", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Sagarmatha is the highest mountain in the whole world.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Up high it is very cold and windy, so climbing is very hard.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: In 1953, Tenzing Norgay Sherpa and Edmund Hillary climbed together.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: On the way, they helped each other.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: And they reached the top! Working together, we can do big things.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "To the Top of Sagarmatha", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Dashain is here! The whole family comes home.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: We grow jamara at home — little green shoots.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Elders put red tika on our forehead and give us their blessings.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Children fly kites and play on the swing.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: At Dashain, we all celebrate happily together.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Dashain Is Here!", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Tihar is the festival of lights and lamps.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Bright Tihar", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: We lovingly give food and flower garlands to crows and dogs.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Bright Tihar", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: We honour the cow, then clean and decorate our homes.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Bright Tihar", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Sisters give their brothers a seven-coloured tika.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Bright Tihar", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Everyone sings Deusi and Bhailo and dances!
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Bright Tihar", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: This is our flag. No other flag in the world has this shape!
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Our Flag", page 1: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Its two triangles look like the peaks of the Himalaya.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Our Flag", page 2: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: Its crimson red is like the rhododendron flower.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Our Flag", page 3: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: It has the moon and the sun.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Our Flag", page 4: storyteller voice, slow and warm.

text_to_say: It carries the wish that Nepal lasts as long as the moon and the sun.
notes: UK ENGLISH voice. Story "Our Flag", page 5: storyteller voice, slow and warm.
